newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse continues quiet but edges higher.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse continues quiet but edges higher.

text.p: Prices edged higher on the Ghana Stock Exchange on Friday but trading continued quiet, dealers said.
"This is a normal situation for the time of year, as investors wait for word on the half-year performance of companies," one dealer said.
The GSE All-Share Index added 0.91 point to 383.60.
The market's biggest stock, Ashanti, fell 50 cedis to 22,000, but Mechanical LLoyd added 10 to 130 and Guinness Ghana Ltd rose two to 362.
